newsitem.title: USA: ECC amends stockholder rights agreement.
newsitem.headline: ECC amends stockholder rights agreement.

text.p: ECC International Corp said Wednesday that it has amended its stockholder rights agreement by increasing the threshold of company shares that must be under beneficial ownership before preferred stock repurchase rights take effect.
The company said it increased the level to 30 percent from 22.5 percent in response to a request from a major shareholder that it terminate the plan.
The company said that it was in the best interests of shareholders to increase the trigger level, effective immediately, in the event the company were confronted with a coercive or unfair takeover.
Shareholders voted in December to seek a sale of the company.
ECC International design and makes simulators for the U.S. Department of Defense and the armed forces in 25 countries.
